page.overview:
Who is Ptar-Axtlan?

Ptar-Axtlan (also spelled Ptar-Aztlan) is a fictional entity created by Gerald W. Page for his Cthulhu Mythos short story "Confession in Darkness".

Known as the Leopard That Stalks the Night, Ptar-Axtlan is a mysterious entity associated with cats. Like Cthulhu and other similar beings, Ptar-Axtlan can grant gifts of immortality and eternal youth to its followers. However, while Cthulhu's followers assume the traits of fish, Ptar-Axtlan's have a more feline appearance. Even a sadistic practitioner of the dark arts shuddered to think about what an entity like Ptar-Axtlan might ask in return for its gifts of unaging beauty. (: "Confession in Darkness")
